title: Whitespace after a throws union separator is accepted

ground_truth.statement: A throws tag contains a type expression; spaces around its union separator do not change the exception alternatives. The runtime controls exercise normal return and the documented exception.

provenance.derivation: Clean-room parser acceptance probe, with actual throw and return controls.

notes: This measures parsing, not enforcement of checked exceptions. InvalidArgumentException is itself an Exception; the redundant alternative is intentional.
